verdicts.reason: Doc drift is real but narrower than claimed: two routes (session seed and restore-session) and the facebookPool.ts caller are missing from the contract docs. The fb_uid failure scenario is already guarded by a console test, and the route-removal scenario requires deleting RS-308-labelled tests; if it happened, a 404 on /session falls back by design to a password Re-login (facebookPool.ts:681-687), which is the login-risk path, so the scenario is reachable but only through a deliberate, test-visible removal. Rated P3 (maintainability/doc drift) rather than P2.
